code: sca_ <- function(a, f) {   function(x) a * f(x) }  add_ <- function(fp, fq) {   function(x) fp(x) + fq(x) }  mul_ <- function(fp, fq) {   function(x) fp(x) * fq(x) }  f1 <- function(x) {   x }  f2 <- function(x) {   x^2 }  f3 <- function(x) {   x^3 }  v <- 1234 w <- 5678

title: Calculate analytical power for Dunnett's multiple-comparison test — dunnett_power_analytic
text: mu0 Numeric scalar. Expected mean control group. mu_t Numeric vector. Expected means treatment groups. n0 Integer. Sample size control group. nt Integer. Sample size treatment group. sigma Numeric scalar. Common residual standard deviation. alpha Numeric scalar. Familywise type error rate.

title: Calculate analytical power for Dunnett's multiple-comparison test — dunnett_power_analytic
text: named list containing: df Residual degrees freedom. crit Two-sided Dunnett critical value. per_comparison_power Numeric vector power values individual     treatment-versus-control comparisons. familywise_power Numeric scalar giving probability least one comparison     exceeds Dunnett critical threshold.

title: Calculate analytical power for Dunnett's multiple-comparison test — dunnett_power_analytic
text: function assumes single control group multiple treatment groups common residual standard deviation. treatment group assumed sample size specified `nt`. Correlations among treatment-versus-control contrasts explicitly accounted contrasts share control group. two-sided Dunnett critical value obtained multivariate t distribution using `mvtnorm::qmvt()`. Per-comparison power calculated corresponding noncentral t distributions. Familywise power defined probability least one treatment-versus-control comparison exceeds Dunnett critical threshold.
